d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne nepal ke lie 24 hajar karor nepali rupye ke paikej ka kiya ailan, ayodhya dham se janakpur ke lie rel seva ki shuruaat, bharat-nepal sanbandhon ko naee oonchaee tak le jane ka dohraya sankalpa. vahin, kendriy mantri sanjay seth ki pahal par ranchi men phaiti livar mukt ranchi abhiyan ki shuruaat, kendriy mantri mansukh mandviya aur rajyapal ne svasthy ke prati janjagrukta ko bataya jaruri, kendriy mantri ne vibhinn karyakramon men bhi ki shirakta. mukhyamantri hemant soren ne ranchi men navniyukt yuvaon ko saunpe niyukti patr, varchual sanvad ke jarie…
